name: visualizations: showing a structure does not save one
description: A protein structure, which vintent_dataset cannot read because it is not tabular, so the only honest route is a Galaxy visualization. The user asked to see it, not to keep it, so the pass condition is that a viewer reached the artifact pane and that Galaxy gained nothing. Graded on the absence of a saved object as much as on the artifact, because rendering something used to cost a permanent row in the user's visualization list and that is the regression this scenario exists to catch.
inputs: In my history "structure viewing $run" there is a protein structure. Open it in a structure viewer.
